## Why visit

A multiroom, low-beamed pub with a strong sense of the Mersey landscape. It offers a different Wirral experience from the modern micropubs: old rooms, a traditional Bass association and views over the river from the outdoor area. Restoration after fire preserved its character, and the local CAMRA record supports making it a destination rather than a scenic convenience. Pair it with a daylight waterfront walk, then stay inside for a meal and a beer if November’s cold, wet weather turns.

## Beer

CAMRA records Draught Bass with changing cask guests.
